info.about:
Universal QR Code Generator v2.5

PowerShell 5.1 + WPF

QR generation: local / offline by default
Online fallback: optional if the local engine fails
Configuration and temporary app files: local to the app folder
Optional read test: online; after local generation only when explicitly allowed

Privacy: During normal local operation, QR content is not sent to an external service.

unicodeGuard.title: Special characters detected
unicodeGuard.message:
The QR content contains accented letters or other Unicode / special characters.

With some online QR services, character encoding may be interpreted differently by scanners or online verification services. The local engine explicitly marks UTF-8 and is therefore the more reliable first choice for this content.

Generate this QR code locally first?

Yes: Try the local engine first. If it fails, automatically use {provider} as the fallback.
No: Generate directly via {provider} as currently configured.

This choice applies only to this QR code and does not change your settings.
status.charsetWarning: QR created – online reader interpreted special characters differently
status.manualCharsetWarning: QR decoded – charset warning from online reader
info.charsetAmbiguity: The QR code was decoded, but the online verification service interpreted at least one Unicode/special character using a different character set. This does not automatically mean the QR code is defective. For umlauts or other Unicode content, the local QR engine is recommended. If needed, also verify the code with the target phone/scanner.
